passages.title: A recycling scheme that worked
passages.text: Two years ago the university installed recycling bins in every dormitory. The first survey was disappointing: only a third of bottles reached the correct bin. Instead of adding more bins, the housing office tried something cheaper. It published a weekly chart in each building showing how much waste had been sorted correctly, and it asked the cleaners to leave one wrongly sorted bag beside the bin with a short note. Within a term the rate rose to nearly three quarters. The lesson is that people do not need more instructions; they need to see how they are doing compared with their neighbours.

paragraphs.zh: 问题：宿舍装了回收桶，但第一次调查只有三分之一瓶子投对。
做法：不加桶，改为每周公布各楼正确率，并让保洁把分错的袋子留在桶边附短说明。
结果与启示：一学期升到近四分之三；人需要的不是更多说明，而是看见自己做得怎样。

vocab.note: The first survey was disappointing
sorted correctly 分类正确
a weekly chart 每周图表
the rate rose to nearly three quarters
compared with their neighbours 与邻楼相比

sentences.main: The housing office tried something cheaper.
sentences.mods: Instead of… 介词短语作状语，表示「而不是」。
sentences.zh: 宿管部门没有增加垃圾桶，而是尝试了更省钱的办法。
sentences.point: 转折句。Instead of 直接否掉「多买桶」的选项，是细节题的分界。

sentences.en: The lesson is that people do not need more instructions; they need to see how they are doing compared with their neighbours.
sentences.main: The lesson is that people need to see how they are doing.
sentences.mods: that 表语从句；how 宾语从句；compared with… 过去分词短语作状语。
sentences.zh: 这一做法的启示是：人们并不需要更多说明，他们需要看到自己与邻居相比做得如何。
sentences.point: 主旨句。not… 与分号后的肯定形成对照，答案应落在「可见的反馈」。

takeaway: 主旨：比起增加设施，让人看见自己与同伴的差距更能改变行为。
命题手法：先给失败数据（one third），再给低成本做法，末句点题。
易错点：把「不是加桶」误读成「桶不重要」，忽略 instead of 只是否定该方案。

passages.title: Older learners and online courses
passages.text: Online courses were expected to be a gift for older learners, who often find it hard to travel to a campus. Participation tells a different story. Adults over sixty enroll in large numbers but complete far fewer courses than younger students. The reasons are practical rather than attitudinal: platforms assume users can navigate menus, upload files and join video calls, and a single confusing step can end the attempt. A pilot programme that paired each learner with a student helper for the first two weeks raised completion sharply. The technology was not the barrier; learning the technology alone was.

paragraphs.zh: 反差：线上课本该方便老年人，报名人数多但完成率远低于年轻人。
原因：不是态度问题，而是操作门槛——菜单、上传、进会议，一步卡住就放弃。
办法：前两周配学生助手，完成率大幅上升；技术不是障碍，独自学技术才是。

vocab.note: practical rather than attitudinal 是操作而非态度问题
navigate menus 操作菜单
a pilot programme 试点项目
raised completion sharply 大幅提高完成率
The technology was not the barrier

sentences.en: The reasons are practical rather than attitudinal: platforms assume users can navigate menus, upload files and join video calls, and a single confusing step can end the attempt.
sentences.mods: rather than 对比；冒号后解释 practical 的具体内容；assume 后接省略 that 的宾语从句。
sentences.zh: 原因是操作层面的，而非态度层面的：平台假定用户会操作菜单、上传文件、加入视频通话，而一个令人困惑的步骤就可能让尝试中断。
sentences.point: 细节题依据。practical rather than attitudinal 一句排除「不愿学」的选项。

sentences.en: The technology was not the barrier; learning the technology alone was.

sentences.mods: 分号连接两个分句；alone 修饰 learning；句末 was 后省略 the barrier。
sentences.zh: 技术本身并不是障碍；真正的障碍在于要独自学会使用这项技术。
sentences.point: 结论句。省略结构是翻译与理解难点，答题时要补出省略成分。

questionMap.locate: 细节题，关键词 older learners，定位 enroll in large numbers but complete far fewer courses

细节题，关键词 pilot programme，定位 raised completion sharply 及其条件「前两周配学生助手」

takeaway: 主旨：老年人线上课完成率低，卡点在操作而非态度；短期人工陪伴能显著提升完成率。
命题手法：先破常识（gift for older learners），再给数据，最后用 not… but… 定性。

passages.title: Bike-sharing after the novelty
passages.text: Bike-sharing arrived with promises of clean transport and crowded streets full of bicycles. Several cities now report a quieter outcome. Ridership peaks in the first year and then flattens, while maintenance costs keep rising. The companies that survive tend to be those that moved bikes to where people actually need them, near metro exits and housing estates, instead of scattering them across the centre. Parking rules matter as much as price. Where bikes may be left only in marked areas, streets stay tidy and the service is used more; where they may be left anywhere, the opposite happens.

paragraphs.zh: 预期与现实：共享单车承诺绿色出行，多城却出现「第一年火热、随后趋平」。
存活关键：把车投到真正有需求的地方（地铁口、住宅区），而非撒在市中心。
规则：指定停车区让街道整洁、使用率更高；随意停放则相反。

vocab.note: Ridership peaks in the first year
then flattens 随后走平
housing estates 住宅小区
scattering them across the centre 撒在市中心
marked areas 指定区域

sentences.main: The companies tend to be those.
sentences.mods: 两个 that 定语从句；where 宾语从句作 to 的宾语；instead of 对比。
sentences.zh: 存活下来的公司往往是那些把车投放到人们真正需要之处——地铁口和住宅区——而不是撒在市中心的公司。
sentences.point: 细节题依据。instead of 否掉「撒在市中心」，near… 给出正确投放点。

sentences.point: 细节题依据。两个 where 形成对照，答案必须体现「规则严→使用多」这一反直觉结论。

questionMap.locate: 细节题，关键词 ridership，定位 peaks in the first year and then flattens

命题手法：数据趋势（peaks then flattens）+ 对比（marked areas vs anywhere）。

passages.title: Volunteering and the first job
passages.text: Employers say they value volunteering, but students often suspect that only impressive internships count. A survey of graduate recruiters suggests the students are half right. Volunteering was rarely listed as a requirement, yet interviewers frequently asked candidates to describe a situation where they had worked with others to solve a problem. A term spent organising a food bank shift supplied better answers than a month of photocopying in an office. The value lies less in the activity itself than in the evidence it provides of reliability, coordination and persistence.

paragraphs.zh: 学生认知：认为只有亮眼实习才算数。
调查结果：志愿经历很少被列为硬性要求，但面试官常问「合作解决问题」的经历。
原因：价值不在活动本身，而在它提供的可靠、协作、坚持的证据。

vocab.note: graduate recruiters 校招招聘官
rarely listed as a requirement
a food bank shift 食物银行的一班岗
evidence of coordination 协作的证据
reliability, coordination and persistence

sentences.zh: 志愿经历很少被列为硬性要求，但面试官常请候选人描述一个与他人合作解决问题的情境。
sentences.point: 细节题依据。「不是要求」与「常被追问」并存，正是 half right 的第一半。

passages.title: The food supermarkets throw away
passages.text: A supermarket throws away food for reasons that have little to do with hunger and everything to do with appearance. A banana with a brown spot, a loaf past its display date, a carton dented in delivery: all are edible, none is sellable by the usual rules. Some chains now sell such items at a discount in a separate aisle, and a few have changed the rules themselves, removing best-before dates from fruit and vegetables. The results are modest but consistent: less waste, lower costs, and customers who say they prefer shops that do it. The obstacle is not customer resistance but the habit of ordering by appearance.

paragraphs.zh: 现象：超市丢弃食物，原因多与外观和日期规则有关，而非不能吃。
做法：设折扣货架、取消部分果蔬的保质期标签，效果是浪费减少、成本下降。
障碍：不是顾客抵触，而是按外观订货的习惯。

a separate aisle 单独的货架区

passages.title: Paying without a smartphone
passages.text: Cashless payment is convenient for anyone who owns a smartphone and frustrating for anyone who does not. Shops that stop accepting cash save time at the counter, but they also exclude older customers and people without a bank account. Several cities have responded with rules requiring retailers to accept cash, and some banks now issue cards with large-print keypads and a single confirmation button. The debate is often framed as progress versus nostalgia. In practice it is a question of design: a payment system is only as good as the number of people who can use it.

paragraphs.zh: 两面性：无现金支付对有机者方便，对无机者构成排斥。
应对：部分城市要求商户收现金，部分银行推出大字键盘、单键确认的卡。
结论：这不是进步与怀旧之争，而是设计问题——好系统取决于有多少人能用。

exclude older customers 把老年顾客排除在外
requiring retailers to accept cash
large-print keypads 大字键盘

sentences.point: 结论句。评判标准是「可用人数」，不是速度或新颖度。

passages.title: Wellness programmes at work
passages.text: Company wellness programmes usually offer gym discounts, fruit in the kitchen and an app that counts steps. Reviews of their effects are mixed. Participation is highest among employees who are already healthy, and the measured improvements are small. Meanwhile the strongest influence on employee health is rarely mentioned: how work is organised. Long and unpredictable hours, low control over tasks and unclear expectations produce stress that no step counter can offset. A few employers have redirected the budget from apps to scheduling, giving teams notice of shifts and a voice in how work is divided. Reported stress fell further than in any of the fitness schemes.

paragraphs.zh: 现状：企业健康项目多是健身折扣、水果、计步 App。
效果有限：参与者本就是健康人群，改善幅度小。
真正的成因：工时长且不可预测、缺乏掌控感、期望不清；改排班比改 App 更有效。

passages.title: Tourism that pays for the place
passages.text: Tourism is often described as an export industry: visitors arrive, spend, and leave. The description hides a cost. A small town that attracts a million visitors a year may find its rents rising, its shops turning into souvenir stalls, and its residents moving away. Some destinations now charge an entry fee and use the money to maintain the very streets that visitors come to see. Others limit the number of cruise ships per day. The measures are unpopular with parts of the industry, but they rest on a simple idea: a place that is pleasant to visit must first be pleasant to live in.

paragraphs.zh: 说法与代价：旅游被说成出口产业，但这个说法掩盖了居民承担的成本。
做法：收门票维护街道、限制每日游轮数量。
理念：宜游之地必先宜居。

vocab.note: an export industry 出口型产业

sentences.mods: 主谓宾结构，短句承担转折功能。
sentences.zh: 这一说法掩盖了一项成本。
sentences.point: 转折句。它否定了「旅游纯属收益」的前提，是推断题「作者为何不满」的依据。

sentences.main: A place must first be pleasant to live in.

sentences.point: 结论句。宜居是宜游的前提，对应「可持续发展」的立场。
